0.content:
# z/VM capacity

Memory overcommit is guest total over host limit. Forecast tiles append the DQL forecast command. All four tiles follow the system and LPAR variables.

State-change logs, when events are enabled: `fetch logs | filter startsWith(event.name, "zvm.")`

1.title: Host memory
1.description: LPAR memory usage from Feilong, in bytes, for the selected system and LPAR.

2.title: Guest memory total
2.description: Guest-reported total memory for the selected system and LPAR. Divide by host memory limit for overcommit.

3.title: Paging forecast
3.description: DQL forecast of paging utilization. A rising forecast through 0.9 inside a week is a warning, not an incident.

4.title: Spool forecast
4.description: DQL forecast of spool utilization. Warning only.
